integrity: Analytical proof from a globally 1-Lipschitz geodesic potential, area-preserving unfolding, exact polar integrals and angular likelihood-ratio order; numerical checks are supplementary. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only right square prisms with positive height and the source at a base-face center.
An unindexed earlier equivalent height-parametric calculation or order theorem remains possible.
No general rectangular-box or two-random-source distribution is claimed.
title: Sharp stochastic height order and exact intrinsic-distance law for square prisms
